items.summary: Recommendation: approve containment-only execution and authorize no discretionary spend, budget commitments, monetization expansion, forecasts, requeues, or new production work. Revenue evidence supports only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; $0 is site-attributed because the aggregate row cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. AI spend was $963.569 across 5,390 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost windows are misaligned, period-aligned domain/infrastructure/labor/marketing/experiment costs are absent, incremental outcomes are not isolated, and monthly limits are blank. Minimum measurement is a dated cost ledger reconciled to site/content identifiers and the revenue window, plus experiment-level incremental outcomes and owner-approved spending limits. Continue only existing source-dated measurement, attribution reconciliation, and repair-or-close work; reject vanity metrics as financial proof.

Retain the candidate plan’s containment-only disposition. The 197 approved proposals without execution, 46 open failure follow-ups, 27 deployed improvements awaiting measurement, and only 1 proven outcome are execution and measurement controls, not evidence of financial return. Continue existing measurement and reconciliation without duplicate telemetry or new finance requests. Do not claim revenue, margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, budget headroom, or causal lift until the required period-aligned ledger and attributable incremental results exist.
